name: Bill Lee
stance: Signed chatbot-adjacent AI laws and an AI safety study; joined governors opposing a federal moratorium on state AI laws.

statements.text: Signed SB 1493, which in its final form orders a TACIR study of AI systems, safety and state protections due January 31, 2027.
Signed SB 1580, barring AI systems from being marketed as qualified mental health professionals.
Signed the 17-governor letter asking Congress to drop the state AI-law moratorium.
statements.outlet: Office of the Governor of Arkansas
